title: A HOUSE TO LET.
summary: Respectable seven-room house near the observatory; dry cellars and an excellent garden. The east parlour is let separately to a scientific society every second Thursday. Prospective tenants must accept that it has no door on those evenings.
author: Agony Column Desk
